description: 3D massive MIMO channel model for high-speed railway wireless communication is a model or code deposit deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Chengjian Liao, Kui Xu. In the fifth generation (5G) wireless communication, high-speed railway(HSR) communication is one of the most challenging scenarios.By adopting massive multi-input multi-output(mMIMO)technology in HSR communication, the design of the underlying communication system becomes more challenging.Some new channel characteristics must be studied, such as non-stationarity in space, time and frequency domains. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2020. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
